name: Muzaffarpur Cube Open 2024

venue.name: P&M Mall
venue.address: Swami Vivekanand Rd, opposite RK Ashram, Muzaffarpur, Bihar 842005

information: * **Participants have to bring their own cube for the event. Check out all the other Tabs for more detailed information.** * **Make sure to be available at the venue at least 15 minutes before your event starts. Late entries won't be allowed to participate.** * **Attend the tutorial session if you're new to WCA competitions or unfamiliar with its rules.** * **Bring a government ID card for verification if it's your first time participating in a WCA competition.** * **Participants are expected to volunteer and will be assigned with roles as judges, scramblers, or runners, with the exception of newcomers.**
